title: The geometry of a counting formula for deformations of the braid arrangement
summary: We consider real hyperplane arrangements whose hyperplanes are of the form $\{x_i - x_j = s\}$ for some integer $s$, which we call deformations of the braid arrangement. In 2018, Bernardi gave a counting formula for the number of regions of any deformation of the braid arrangement $\mathcal{A}$ as a signed sum over some decorated trees. He further showed that each of these decorated trees can be associated to a region $R$ of the arrangement $\mathcal{A}$, and hence we can consider the contribution of each region to the signed sum.
